literal: In mind those who do not agree, in whatever measure anything, by word, of the nature of trusting it is not.
translation: It is never right to trust the words of those whose minds do not agree with yours, no matter what they say.
modern: மனத்தால் நம்மோடு பொருந்தாதவர்களை, அவர்கள் சொல்லும் சொற்களைக் கொண்டு எந்த அளவிலும் நம்புவது கூடாது.
explanation: This couplet warns against trusting people who harbor inner enmity while speaking friendly words. The phrase 'மனத்தின் அமையாதவரை' refers to those whose minds are not aligned or in harmony with ours. 'எனைத்தொன்றும்' emphasizes that one should not trust them even a little bit or in any matter. 'சொல்லினால் தேறற்பாற்று அன்று' concludes that relying merely on their spoken words is not a trustworthy course of action, as their outward speech contradicts their inner feelings.
